answer: The help center doesn't name any lenders outside the e-payoff network, so I can't give you that list; please check with a store for lender records. It only lists the network lenders: Bayline Credit Union, Northwind Auto Finance, Meridian Auto Loans, Pinewood Federal Credit Union and Lakeshore Bank, plus Granite Bank, which joined on March 15, 2026. Customers with any other lender must bring a payoff letter or sign form NW-LPA-1 so we can request one, which takes about 2 business days. NW-LPA-1 is for loans only; leases use a dealer payoff quote or form NW-LSE-1.
